analyst_view.overall: Sabah are 31st of 36 with 3 points and Barcelona 5th with 9, level with ninth place, so Barcelona need the win to stay in the top 8 and the Spanish press calls Baku a key game. Sabah moved their league game forward to rest, won it 5-1 against Sumgayit, and Valdas Dambrauskas promises a compact side that wants to compete; Aden McCarthy's ban is counted. What changed: the numbers now count Rodri and Xavi Espart for Barcelona, so my trim gets smaller, but Barcelona beat Villarreal 3-2 on Sunday after a long flight is still ahead, Marc Bernal went off injured late (one report) and Flick faces nine games in 27 days, so some rotation is expected between Baku and the trip to Deportivo. Dani Olmo, Jules Koundé and Eric García are back; Roony Bardghji and Andreas Christensen are out. No referee is named yet.

goals.text: The numbers say 5.0 goals (1.1 Sabah, 4.0 Barcelona), already counting Barcelona's strong scoring run, McCarthy's ban and now also Rodri and Espart. What they can't see is likely rotation after Sunday's game and before Deportivo, with a long trip to Baku; with Rodri now counted I cut my trim from 6% to 4%, to about 4.8.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.7 corners, 6.7 of them for Barcelona as the side that will have most of the ball against a deep Sabah block. Rotation could make Barcelona a little less sharp, but a compact defence still concedes plenty of corners, as Barcelona's 30 shots against Villarreal showed, so I stay at 9.7.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.5 cards, already counting Sabah's high recent card count (+11.5%), which fits a side chasing the ball all night, and Barcelona's quieter spell (-4.7%). No referee is named yet and I see nothing beyond that, so I stay at 4.5.

shots.text: The numbers say 34.6 shots (8.9 Sabah, 25.7 Barcelona), already lifted for Barcelona's heavy recent shooting (+10.5%). A partly rotated Barcelona after a Sunday game and a long flight may shoot a little less than their recent peak, so I trim to about 33.2.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 12.3 shots on target, already raised for Barcelona's sharp recent finishing (+8.3%). The same reason, likely rotation and travel, points slightly lower, to about 11.8.
